what: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
title: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
text: blfs R package makes easier work large files GitHub projects. default: GitHub doesn’t let upload files larger 100 MB. Git LFS (Large File Storage) raises limit 2 GB, still problems: Free accounts storage cap. Even delete file, stays hidden project’s history still takes space. Completely removing files often means recreating whole repository losing commit history. Wildfire Water Security (WWS) project, unlimited storage Box. blfs lets us keep big files Box still using GitHub everything else — get best worlds.

title: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
text: Instead storing big file directly GitHub, blfs creates small pointer file says real file lives Box. pointer files extension .boxtracker stored GitHub. actual large files live Box, inside special box-lfs folder.

title: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
text: Git project, ’s good practice : Pull changes GitHub start work day. Push changes GitHub ’re done day making big change. Box LFS, even important. Box LFS doesn’t track every little change inside large file; stores new version time update . don’t keep changes people make, can run something called merge conflict. merge conflict happens : commit changes tracked file locally (don’t push GitHub yet). Meanwhile, someone else changes file copy pushes GitHub. finally try push changes, GitHub says: “two versions file don’t match — can’t decide one correct.” Box LFS projects, usually means .boxtracker files large file different commit . safest way avoid ? Pull first, push often.

what: What to do if you get a merge conflict
title: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
text: try pull push changes Git shows something like: Example merge conflict Don’t worry, just means version file version GitHub different, Git wants choose one keep.

what: Step 1: Decide which version to keep
title: Track Large Project Files Stored on Box
text: Open conflicted file R text editor look two versions. Open file Box see recent version. Ask : upload latest version large file Box? → Keep pointer file. someone else upload newer version Box? → Keep pointer file. Tip: versions large file important, rename one uploading Box project can keep without overwriting. can update path-hash.csv .boxtracker file match.
